title: About us
description: How Luna Café started: our story, the people behind the counter and what the papers wrote about us.

props.title: Our story
props.subtitle: We've been making coffee downtown since 2019, with care and a lot of patience.

props.title: How it started
props.text:
We started with a single espresso machine and a lot of stubbornness, in a room of about 200 square feet.

Today we have 12 seats, a terrace full of flowers and the best carrot cake in the neighborhood. Come and see for yourself!

props.title: The team
props.subtitle: The people behind the counter, the roaster and the oven.

people.name: Emma Carter
people.text: She opened Luna in 2019 with one espresso machine and three tables. She still picks the beans.

people.name: Mike Russo
people.text: He roasts the beans every Tuesday and knows every batch by heart.

people.name: Anna Price
people.text: The carrot cake is hers. So are the croissants, ready at 7 every morning.

props.title: How we grew, year by year

moments.title: We open with one espresso machine and three tables
moments.text: A tiny room on Linden Street and a short menu: espresso, cappuccino and carrot cake.

moments.title: Coffee through the window
moments.text: When nobody could sit inside, we served through the window. The neighbors came by every morning.

moments.title: The flower terrace
moments.text: Four tables outside and geraniums in pots. From April to October, it's everyone's favorite spot.

moments.title: We start roasting our own
moments.text: A small roaster in the back and our first bags of beans to take home. We share every new batch in our [news](/).

moments.title: Our first tasting
moments.text: Three different beans, their stories and twelve full seats. We've held one every year since.

moments.title: 12 seats and a team of five
moments.text: We knocked through the wall into the old storeroom. Now there's room for everyone, laptops and strollers alike.

props.title: In the press
props.subtitle: A few lines from the papers and blogs that came through our door.

articles.text: A report from the flower terrace: how one espresso machine and three tables grew into a café with its own roaster.
The best carrot cake in town comes from a 12-seat café on Linden Street.
Luna is the kind of place where the barista remembers what you drink. The V60 with the beans of the week: jasmine and peach, just as promised.
